target: sign(count[t]-count[t-2]); latest available count to target, NOT one-year t-1 to t change
population: positive count at t-2; t-3 observed; missing target excluded, observed zero retained
selection: choose baseline and model on development only
gate: at least 0.03 balanced accuracy gain pooled and positive gain in both evaluation years
limitations: brand count growth is not profit or recommendation
